correction: The OFA tutorial 20-block, five-stage controller domain belongs to OFA-MobileNetV3 and must not be relabelled as an official Proxyless-MobileNetV2 tutorial domain.

upstream_evidence.claim: The tutorial evolution manager uses five stages, 20 blocks, and resolutions 160,176,192,208,224.
OFA Proxyless constructs five max-depth groups plus one fixed-depth final group.
OFA Proxyless accepts ks/e for len(blocks)-1 positions and fixes only the final group depth to one.
The released Proxyless supernet domain uses resolution 128-224 and width 1.3.

scientific_boundary: The model/search domain is source-backed, but replacing an accuracy predictor or hardware-aware objective with a ZCP under the project generic evolutionary controller is a project transfer experiment, not an official OFA ZCP protocol.
